response.sql: SELECT r.raceId, r.name, AVG(CASE WHEN TRIM(res.laps) GLOB '[0-9]*' THEN CAST(res.laps AS REAL) END) AS average_laps FROM races AS r JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId WHERE res.positionOrder >= 12 GROUP BY r.raceId, r.name ORDER BY average_laps IS NULL, average_laps DESC, r.raceId LIMIT 10;
